key_reasoning.reason: New cloud-provider-conflict module (provider, resolver, prompt, gate, switcher) wired into three entry flows: AgentCLI launch, codemie install claude, and proxy connect orchestrator plus the Desktop connector. It reuses shared helpers in claude-code-otlp claude-settings-env and evidence/routing, which were also modified.

Rewrites users' Claude Code, Claude Desktop and VS Code settings files. It adds a layered precedence resolver (managed plist/registry/drop-ins, project, local, user, env), a byte-exact credential-bearing backup at 0600, atomic writes with mtime/size change detection, and rollback on partial failure. There is no exact precedent for this, and it is security-sensitive (secrets in backups, values never logged). The edge cases are enumerated (managed policy, unknown, non-interactive, cancel), and each has a dedicated test suite.

24 files and 4658 insertions across src/agents/core, src/agents/plugins/claude, src/agents/plugins/claude-code-otlp and src/cli/commands (install, proxy, connectors). About 5 new source modules and 8 new test files. Roughly 14 of the files are tests, which lifts the count but not the product risk proportionally.

CLI (prompt and guidance), service logic (resolver, gate), persistence (settings file read, backup and atomic write on the filesystem), and infrastructure/OS policy sources (macOS plist via plutil, Windows registry via reg). The settings belong to three external tools (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at XL: security-sensitive handling of credentials in backups, with writes to user config files and rollback
Component Scope XL: touches shared utilities (claude-settings-env, routing) and multiple workflows (agent launch, install, proxy connect)
